name: Bryant University Precollege Summer Programs
description_short: Week long day programs on the Bryant campus in Smithfield for high school students, taught by Bryant faculty. Recent offerings were economics of social issues, actuarial science and statistics, and an AI and data science camp with Python, 3D printing and robots.

sessions.name: Precollege Actuarial Science and Statistics Summer Program

notes: Each program is 9:00 to 3:00 and takes applications. Economics and actuarial tuition ($600) includes all meals and materials; the AI camp's $200 registration fee covers materials. No application fee. Summer 2027 details not yet announced.

for_andrew: Three separate programs on one campus, each with its own page, price and contact. I made one listing with each program as a session, since they share a place. Split into three if you'd rather.
Only the 2026 season is posted and it is over; Bryant says 2027 details will be announced.
Sessions draw on three pages (economics site, actuarial site, AI flyer) but the sessions field can carry only one source; I put it on the economics page.
